facts: The two triangles are similar because they share equal angles: the sun's rays meet the ground at the same angle for both objects.
Pair the corresponding sides — height with height, shadow with shadow.
The scale factor is $k=\dfrac{\text{a length in one triangle}}{\text{the matching length in the other}}$, and every pair of corresponding sides gives the same $k$.
Multiply a known length by $k$, or divide by it, to find the unknown corresponding length.
Check the answer is sensible — a taller object casts a longer shadow.
steps: Identify the two similar triangles and the pairs of corresponding sides.
Find the scale factor by dividing a pair of matching sides.
Multiply or divide by the scale factor to find the unknown length.

workedExamples.solution_text:
The triangles are similar: both have a right angle, and the sunlight makes the same angle with the ground. Match shadow with shadow and height with height.

Post : tree:
$\begin{array}{c|c|c} &\text{Post}&\text{Tree}\\\hline\text{Shadow (m)}&2.5&10\\\text{Height (m)}&1.5&h\end{array}$

$\begin{align*}k&=\frac{10}{2.5}\\k&=4\\h&=1.5\times4\\h&=6\text{ m}\end{align*}$

The similar triangles share the angle at the shadow tip and each has a right angle. The lamp triangle's base includes the person's shadow and the distance to the lamp.

$\begin{align*}b&=8+2\\b&=10\text{ m}\end{align*}$

Lamp triangle : person triangle:
$\begin{array}{c|c|c} &\text{Lamp}&\text{Person}\\\hline\text{Base (m)}&10&2\\\text{Height (m)}&7&h\end{array}$

$\begin{align*}k&=\frac{2}{10}\\k&=\frac15\\h&=7\times\frac15\\h&=1.4\text{ m}\end{align*}$

To find a lamp's height when the person's height is known, use the reverse scale factor: whole base divided by shadow length.

The triangles are similar because both are right-angled and the cables meet the ground at the same angle. Match cable with cable and vertical height with vertical height.

Short cable triangle : long cable triangle:
$\begin{array}{c|c|c} &\text{Short}&\text{Long}\\\hline\text{Cable (m)}&6&15\\\text{Height (m)}&4&h\end{array}$

$\begin{align*}k&=\frac{15}{6}\\k&=2.5\\h&=4\times2.5\\h&=10\text{ m}\end{align*}$

Match $AB$ with $BC$ and $AD$ with $CE$. The triangles have equal right angles and equal vertically opposite angles at $B$.

Small triangle : large triangle:
$\begin{array}{c|c|c} &\text{Small}&\text{Large}\\\hline\text{Horizontal side (m)}&3&9\\\text{Vertical side (m)}&2&w\end{array}$

$\begin{align*}k&=\frac93\\k&=3\\w&=2\times3\\w&=6\text{ m}\end{align*}$

If the horizontal side is unknown instead, find the scale factor from the vertical sides and apply it to the matching horizontal side.

The triangles are similar, so the height ratio also gives the shadow ratio.

$\begin{align*}k&=\frac{10}{2}\\k&=5\end{align*}$

The flagpole's shadow is $5d$. Subtract the person's shadow to use the given difference.

$\begin{align*}5d-d&=12\\4d&=12\\d&=3\text{ m}\end{align*}$

mastery.solution_text:
$k=\frac{8}{1.6}=5$
The flagpole's shadow is $5d$, where $d$ is the person's shadow.
$5d-d=6$
$4d=6$
$d=1.5\text{ m}$
